gitCommit.subject: privacy: real account deletion — purge owned data + scrub PII (pv9 PR6) (#240)
gitCommit.body:
privacy: real account deletion — purge owned data + scrub PII (pv9 PR6) (#240)

* feat(privacy): AccountDeletionService — cascade owned data + scrub PII (purses-hybm)

Replace UserRepository.softDelete (only nulled emailVerified) with a real
AccountDeletionService that permanently erases a user's data:

Owned collections: children-first hard delete in one withTransaction per
collection (sort_result_shares → sort_result_items → sort_results →
decision_events → sessions → preferences → photos → items → invitations →
memberships → collection). Partial failure is logged; remaining collections
continue (per spec).

Borrowed collections: curator-scoped slice deleted child-first across all
collections in one pass per table (shares → result-items → sort-results →
decision-events → sessions → preferences → memberships). Owner's own rows
in those collections are NOT touched.

User row + auth: email → tombstone deleted+<id>@deleted.invalid (satisfies
unique index), name/image/password/emailVerified → null; account + session +
verificationToken rows hard-deleted.

Blobs: best-effort del after commit (mirrors CollectionPurgeService).

New repo methods added (7 repos): deleteByCurator on
SortResultShareRepository, SortResultItemRepository, SortResultRepository,
DecisionEventRepository, SessionRepository,
CollectionPreferenceItemRepository; deleteByUser on MembershipRepository;
purgeAndScrub on UserRepository.

Wire: UserController.deleteCurrentUser now delegates to
AccountDeletionService; route passes db; DELETE response is { message }.

Tests: account-deletion.integration.test.ts (4 tests, RUN_DB_TESTS-gated)
covers full cascade + borrowed-slice isolation + PII scrub + blob del + IDOR
+ non-vacuous sabotage proof. Flips the hybm pin in public-account-routes
from soft-delete to real scrub.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* feat(privacy): account-deletion repo primitives — findByOwnerIncludingDeleted, scrubUploader, scrubEmail, transactional purgeAndScrub (purses-hybm)

- CollectionRepository.findByOwnerIncludingDeleted: enumerate owned
  collections incl. soft-deleted (F1) — findByOwner skips archived ones.
- PhotoRepository.scrubUploader(userId, tombstone): de-identify (not delete)
  photos the user uploaded into OTHER owners' collections (F2).
- InvitationRepository.scrubEmail(oldEmail, tombstone): de-identify an
  accepted invitation's email in another owner's collection (F3).
- UserRepository.purgeAndScrub: wrap the 4 statements in one withTransaction
  and return the captured oldEmail (F5); use the shared tombstone.
- account-tombstone.ts: single deleted+<id>@deleted.invalid convention reused
  by the user row, photo uploaders, and invitation emails.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(privacy): account deletion — purge soft-deleted owned collections (reuse CollectionPurgeService), scrub borrowed photo/invitation PII, abort-before-scrub on failure, transactional (purses-hybm)

Whole-branch review BLOCK fixes:
- F1+F6a: enumerate owned collections via findByOwnerIncludingDeleted and
  purge each through CollectionPurgeService (canonical cascade + collection.purge
  audit row + blob del) — fixes skipped archived collections and cascade drift.
- F4: run ALL owned purges first; if ANY throws, abort AFTER the loop, BEFORE
  the borrowed pass and BEFORE purgeAndScrub, so the route returns 500 and the
  op is retryable with PII intact. Never scrub a user who still owns data.
- F2: scrub photos.uploaded_by → tombstone (rows survive — V's shared content).
- F3: scrub invitations.email (by old email) → tombstone (row survives).
- F5: wrap the 7 borrowed-slice deletes in one withTransaction (tx-bound repos);
  purgeAndScrub is transactional (in the repo commit).

Tests (RED-first, verified by reverting each fix): F1 soft-deleted owned
collection purged + blob del'd; F6a collection.purge audit row written; F2
borrowed photo row survives with tombstoned uploaded_by, blob NOT del'd; F3
borrowed invitation row survives with tombstoned email; F4 forced purge failure
leaves PII intact + account/session present + borrowed slice untouched + 500.
Existing non-vacuous happy-path stays green.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH
